strings.mountFailure:
Filesystem startup failed; check configured disks
Required: WORK: on D8:
Use CD SYS: to retry; cold-boot after SIO failure

assumptions: IDE worker opens only its immutable timer.device request
IORESIDENT callbacks on this worker therefore select timer.device
COP policy switches to the reserved kernel stack; interrupt frames use the 256-byte reserve
Emitted worker paths use direct calls; known targets match every compiler call-map entry
